# Collaborative Whiteboard

> Open-source real-time collaborative whiteboard.

## Project documentation

- README.md: Project overview and setup.
- CONTRIBUTING.md: Contribution guidelines.
- AGENTS.md: AI coding agent instructions.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: System architecture.
- docs/REALTIME.md: Socket.IO communication.
- docs/CANVAS.md: Canvas rendering and elements.
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md: Development environment.
- docs/ROADMAP.md: Planned improvements.

## Development

The application uses a shared canvas model and
real-time collaboration.

Read the relevant architecture documentation
before modifying core functionality.

## Contribution

Both human and AI-assisted contributions are
welcome. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md.
